plain_summary: Oral small-molecule GLP-1 (Foundayo/orforglipron, FDA-approved Apr 2026) turns weight-loss from a supply-constrained niche into a mass-market behavioral shift. The mispriced trade is not the drug makers (LLY/NVO avoided — zero margin of safety, drug-pricing risk) but SHORTING the downstream demand-destruction losers: packaged food/snacking (MDLZ, PEP, HSY), legacy diabetes/sleep med-tech (RMD, DXCM, MDT), and the stranded injectable supply chain (WST, STVN). Long side is small: lifestyle beneficiaries (CAVA, LULU, CELH) and US small-molecule solid-dose API (TMO). Strict US-listed liquidity only — short borrow costs paramount; European CDMOs abandoned. Central risk is 'thesis right, LLY captures all value / market reads food volume drop as macro weakness not structural.'
